newsitem.title: USA: Soros group holds 7.22 pct Amati stake.
newsitem.headline: Soros group holds 7.22 pct Amati stake.

text.p: A group including international financier George Soros said Wednesday it holds the equivalent of a 7.22 percent stake or 1,280,010 common shares in Amati Communications Corp.
The group made the disclosure in a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission.

According to the filing, investment partnerships controlled by Soros and Purnendu Chatterjee, an investment manager who is Soros' partner in a number of investments, agreed to buy, at a 15 percent discount from market price, shares of Amati for $15 million.

The agreement required the partnerships to buy shares in two tranches, one worth $10 million and the second at $5 million. A "put" notice was delivered by Amati on October 24 on the first tranche and closing is expected to take place within 60 days.
The partnerships, including Quantum Industrial Partners LDC, S-C Phoenix Holdings LLC, and Winston Partners L.P., will receive a total of 679,710 shares at the closing.
Under the investment agreement, the San Jose, Calif.,-based Amati also gave the partnerships class A and class B warrants to buy a total of 600,000 shares.

The class A warrants are exercisable after December 17 and expire five years later at a price of $17.45 a share. The class B warrants are also exercisable after December 17 and expire in five years at a price of $25.00 a share.
The group said it holds the stake for investment purposes.
